medications.purpose: First‑line blood pressure control for essential hypertension (stage 1) and cardioprotective benefit
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG136 recommends ACE‑inhibitor as step 1 therapy for patients <55 y and non‑Afro‑Caribbean (or when no contraindication) with monitoring of renal function and potassium

medications.dose: 80 mg orally once daily in the evening
medications.duration: Lifelong – lipid profile re‑checked at 3 months then annually
medications.purpose: Treat atherogenic dyslipidaemia (LDL 160 mg/dL, HDL 28 mg/dL) and reduce cardiovascular risk
medications.nice_justification: NICE CG126/NG185 recommends high‑intensity statin (e.g., atorvastatin 80 mg) for all patients with IHD or high‑risk dyslipidaemia to achieve ≥40 % reduction in non‑HDL‑C

treatment_summary: Start ramipril 2.5 mg daily and titrate to the optimal tolerated dose (max 10 mg) for lifelong hypertension control, with renal and potassium monitoring per NICE NG136. Initiate high‑intensity atorvastatin 80 mg nightly for lifelong lipid lowering, with baseline LFTs and CK and lipid monitoring per NICE CG126/NG185. Non‑pharmacological measures (diet, exercise, weight loss, salt restriction) should be reinforced. Follow‑up BP in 2 weeks, labs at 2 weeks and 3 months, then annual review.
